scope: First grouped SVM reconstruction on the frozen original benchmark; not historical leave-one-out reproduction
feature_scaling: none; equation-6 feature vectors used directly, without fitted normalization

layers.layer2: strong versus weak among known enhancers, w=0.4

tie_break: highest exact mean score, then smaller C, then smaller gamma
decision_rule: LIBSVM prediction at its zero decision boundary; positive decision score favors label 1; no threshold tuning or calibration
distance_cache: Label-independent squared Euclidean distances only; no statistics fitted on held-out rows. Kernels are sliced to explicit train/train and validation/train indices.
final_model_selection: After nested evaluation, independently select C/gamma by mean balanced accuracy over the five saved outer folds, then fit all benchmark records for that layer. This full-data selection is not a new performance estimate.

bootstrap.unit: whole evaluation group within each outer fold
bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentile of record-weighted metrics; conditional on saved fitted models and folds

reporting: Per-fold metrics, macro mean across outer folds, pooled threshold metrics and conditional group-bootstrap intervals. AUC/AP are macro averages of within-fold rankings, avoiding cross-model score comparisons.
boundary_rule: Report search-boundary selections; do not expand the grid after seeing outer performance.
